title: Preview, publish or resume your booking page
summary: Review the real saved page and explicitly choose when clients can book online.

sections.title: Before publishing
sections.body: Complete online readiness, including public contacts and policies, a valid booking link and at least one eligible online service with qualified online staff and usable hours. Only authorized business settings users can publish.

sections.title: Review and go live
sections.body:
1. Open **Business setup → Online booking**.
2. Switch between **Desktop** and **Mobile** and review your business details and services.
3. Check opening-week information and the client-facing policy and legal links below the preview.
4. Select **I reviewed this preview** once it has loaded and you have checked it.
5. Read each remaining blocker and use its **Review** action to correct it.
6. When ready, select **Go live with online booking**. For a previously published page, the action is **Resume online booking**.
7. Once the state is **Live**, use **Copy booking link** and open the link separately to check the public experience.

sections.title: What the preview can do
sections.body: The preview uses your saved booking page and catalogue. It lets you inspect presentation and services; it does not reserve times, confirm appointments or publish by itself. Available times are calculated when a client books.

sections.title: Pause and recover
sections.body: To pause new online booking, turn off **Accept online bookings** in Booking preferences and save. Existing appointments remain. Review the page again before resuming. Online deposit payment is not yet available for completing deposit-required bookings; do not rely on a deposit rule to collect public payments.

screenshots.caption: The preview is private until you explicitly go live.
